findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 16 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 80 questions numbered 1-80; by section: 16.1 7, 16.2 7, 16.3 4, 16.4 16, 16.5 22, 16.6 12, 16.7 12. Keys: {'a': 20, 'b': 20, 'c': 20, 'd': 20}.

Covers sections 16.1-16.7 in order (general instructions, hazards, waste disposal, first aid, acid-base titration, anion tests, basic-radical tests); the few numericals (burette volume, molarity equation, phenolphthalein solution) use new values recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: biological hazards 'are allergens', burns matched as in the correction box (acid burn: sodium bicarbonate; alkali burn: 1% acetic acid; bromine burn: 2% ammonia), end point pink to colourless when acid is added to NaOH, aluminium is the reducing agent (not a cathode) in the nitrate test.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
